text:
Opus 5 is dumb and lazy. It just keep guessing what's wrong in my host instead actually run a Linux command to diagnose what's wrong.
I know I can add some Linux diagx skill to Claude Code to make it behaves, but the thing is Opus actually know how to do it within its own weights. I just have to yell at it saying it is dumb and lazy, then it will do its job properly.
